summary: Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of a Class A meeting and an extraordinary general meeting held on August 18, 2026. Shareholders approved increasing Class B ordinary share voting rights from 30 to 200 votes per share and adopting amended articles. The Class B shareholder entered a voting rights waiver agreement waiving the additional 170 votes. No acquisition, divestiture, or other standard special-situation event is present; this is a corporate governance and capital structure change.
